hint.zh-CN: /hello 和 hello_world 工具都会使用这句话。
hint.en: Used by both /hello and the hello_world tool.

hint.zh-CN: 非空时追加在每条发往 WebUI 的回复末尾（演示 on_decorating_result）。
hint.en: When set, added to the end of every reply sent to the WebUI (shows on_decorating_result).

description.zh-CN: 丢弃这些来源的主动事件
description.en: Drop proactive events from these sources

hint.zh-CN: 演示 on_proactive_event：例如填写 email 后，邮件事件在分诊前被丢弃。主人设定的提醒不受影响。
hint.en: Shows on_proactive_event: for example, with email listed, email events are dropped before triage. Reminders set by the owner aren't affected.

hint.zh-CN: 演示 on_proactive_judged：分诊重要性低于此值的事件直接丢弃（0 为不处理）。
hint.en: Shows on_proactive_judged: events with a triage importance below this are dropped (0 turns it off).
